description: 麵攤阿婆（ah_po）的建置配方：build_character.py 依這份檔案從頭產出角色。每個步驟的輸入輸出見 design/03-art-pipeline/CHARACTER_PIPELINE.md。
name: 麵攤阿婆

design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, saturated neon accents. Full body, strict side view facing right, standing upright with the arms relaxed at the sides and empty hands, the far-side leg hidden behind the near leg. an elderly noodle stall owner grandmother, short and plump, about six heads tall: grey hair tied under a cloth head scarf, a kind wrinkled face, a worn apron over a warm orange patterned blouse, loose trousers, rubber sandals, rolled-up sleeves. Empty hands.
